name: UFortGameplayAbility__ApplyProjectileInaccuracy
signature: FVector UFortGameplayAbility::ApplyProjectileInaccuracy(const FVector& Origin, const FVector& AimLocation) const
inc_or_decl:
// Scales an inaccuracy factor from distance and the ability range fields (+0x8c0..+0x8e0), then jitters the aim with rand(). Returns AimLocation unchanged when the jitter result is at or below 0.1. Structure MEDIUM, constants LOW.
FVector ApplyProjectileInaccuracy(const FVector& Origin, const FVector& AimLocation) const;
